investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Orbcrest Clinics (clinic and patient management SaaS); Platform: AWS us-east-2 (zones us-east-2a/us-east-2b/us-east-2c); network range 10.149.0.0/16; Streaming: Kafka cluster of three brokers (single log directory each); topic billing-events uses replication factor 2 and min.insync.replicas 2; producer billing-api, consumer consent-svc; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
